timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1,527 KRW/USD (approached 1,540 during the day)

WHY: The won is currently WEAK at ~1,527–1,540 KRW per USD, meaning you need more Korean won to buy your $2,000. News reports expect upward pressure on the rate next week, with forecasts suggesting the 1,500–1,530 range will persist or worsen, driven by a hawkish Fed and yen weakness.

TIP: Consider waiting a few weeks or spreading your monthly $2,000 purchase across multiple dates to reduce timing risk, since the won is expected to stay weak in the near term.
